verses.html: 35 Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
verses.text: 35 Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.

verses.html: 36 Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
verses.text: 36 Simon and his companions went to look for Him,

verses.html: 37 and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
verses.text: 37 and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”

verses.html: 38 But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
verses.text: 38 But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”

verses.html: 39 So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
verses.text: 39 So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

verses.html: 35 And in the morning, {while it was} still very dark, having gotten up, he went out and went away to a desolate place, and there he was praying.
verses.text: 35 And in the morning, {while it was} still very dark, having gotten up, he went out and went away to a desolate place, and there he was praying.

verses.html: 36 And Simon and the ones with him pursued him
verses.text: 36 And Simon and the ones with him pursued him

verses.html: 37 and found him and say to him, “All are seeking you.”
verses.text: 37 and found him and say to him, “All are seeking you.”

verses.html: 38 And he says to them, “Let us go elsewhere, into the surrounding towns, so that I may preach there also, because for this I went out.”

verses.html: 39 And he went in all Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and casting out the demons.
verses.text: 39 And he went in all Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and casting out the demons.

verses.html: 35 Jesus woke up early the next morning, before sunrise. He left {the house} and walked to a place where no one lived. He prayed {to God} there.
verses.text: 35 Jesus woke up early the next morning, before sunrise. He left {the house} and walked to a place where no one lived. He prayed {to God} there.

verses.html: 36 {When they realized that Jesus was gone}, Simon and other people with him urgently searched for Jesus.
verses.text: 36 {When they realized that Jesus was gone}, Simon and other people with him urgently searched for Jesus.

verses.html: 37 When they found Jesus, they told him, “Almost everybody {in the town of Capernaum} is trying to find you. {We think that you should return there with us.}”
verses.text: 37 When they found Jesus, they told him, “Almost everybody {in the town of Capernaum} is trying to find you. {We think that you should return there with us.}”

verses.html: 38 Jesus replied, “{I will not return with you.} I need to do what I am here to do. So, we need to visit other towns in this area. That way, I can preach {the good news} in those places too.”
verses.text: 38 Jesus replied, “{I will not return with you.} I need to do what I am here to do. So, we need to visit other towns in this area. That way, I can preach {the good news} in those places too.”

verses.html: 39 So Jesus and his apprentices visited all the towns in the region of Galilee. Jesus preached {the good news} in the Jewish meeting places. Also, he forced demons out of people.
